paragraphs: I build backend and full-stack systems with Java, Spring Boot, Python and FastAPI. My focus is microservices, distributed systems, REST APIs and event-driven architecture on AWS, Kafka and Kubernetes.

At Eli Lilly I build serverless data ingestion and production AI systems. These include a platform that processes 20M+ insurance records per day and AskX, a multi-agent RAG platform that handles 200K clinical-trial queries per day.

Earlier, at Blue Cross Blue Shield, I built cloud-native healthcare services, secured internal microservices with OAuth 2.0 and JWT, and cut incident mean time to resolution by 25% with centralized logging and monitoring.
My career started in payments at Paytm and travel marketplaces at Isango. I care about reliability, performance and maintainable software that creates measurable business value.
